reviews.text: Friendly and compassionate service.  I would recommend World of Animals at Mayfair to anyone looking for outstanding veterinary care.
Great Doc (Tancredi), great staff !   Very compassionate people....Wish they would keep longer hours and be open sunday....maybe one day.....

Staff was professional and vet’s assistant was very nice to my cat. The vet was kind and took very good care of my cat. She answered my questions and gave me a few recommendations. I definitely will be returning.

So here’s an update: I had to take my cat back to the vet. When Dr. Tincrety entered the room with a student, she was totally absentmindedly talking to me as if it was my first time there. She wasn’t nice like she was the first visit and was talking fast. She was checking over my cat and did not remember his name. I’ve decided not to return to this vet. If you cannot remember my face or my pet, not to mention table side manners, why even bother to return? Besides I found a vet for half the price. I do not recommend.

My 1st time there the nursed and dr.Tancredi
were so nice I was very pleased on how they handled luna I highly recommend them thank you for taking such good care of luna

The best veterinarians, and staff as well.  Professional, caring, and empathetic. They do not pressure you into doing any unnecessary testing on your pets. They explain the problem in detail, & give you the best options for your pets's health & well being.
My cat can be very aggressive, especially when getting her nails trimmed. Everyone there is very kind, understanding, compassionate and patient with her.

I always know that my concerns regarding my pets are heard and my feelings are respected. They work with us to find the best plan for our pets care. Their empathy of how we love them is recognized and appreciated.
07/15/2026- I and my wife have been coming to W of A on and off for 14 years and we have brought all our pets records from a previous Veterinarian about 6 years ago. The satisfaction with our experience today has been the same since making that change. The level of care, accessibility, and the organized approach towards servicing my pet's needs today and since was done compassionately as always. That process has been unchanging since my first visit.

I had such a wonderful experience at this veterinary office! The entire staff was friendly, professional, and genuinely caring from the moment we walked in. They treated my cat Anastacio with so much kindness, patience, and compassion, which immediately made me feel comfortable and reassured.

The veterinarian took the time to listen to my concerns, explain everything clearly, and answer all of my questions without making me feel rushed. You can truly tell that everyone here loves animals and cares about their well-being.

It’s not always easy trusting someone with your fur baby, but I felt completely confident that my pet was in great hands. I’m extremely grateful for the excellent care we received and would absolutely recommend this office to anyone looking for a compassionate and trustworthy veterinary team. ❤️🐾
